rows.en: Quick start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for NUTRITION ACTORS
rows.ne: पोषण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूका लागि MHPSS न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेजको शीघ्र सुरुवात मार्गदर्शिका
rows.bt: Quick-start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for actors working in the nutrition sector

rows.section: Quick start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for NUTRITION ACTORS
rows.en: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोगको न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज (MSP) के हो?
rows.bt: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: The MSP outlines priority activities to meet the mental health and psychosocial support needs of emergency-affected populations.
rows.ne: आपत्कालबाट प्रभावित जनसङ्ख्याका मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोगसम्बन्धी आवश्यकताहरू पूरा गर्न MSP ले प्राथमिकताका गतिविधिहरूको रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत गर्छ।
rows.bt: The MSP outlines priority activities to meet the mental health and psychosocial support needs of populations affected by emergencies.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: It is based on existing guidelines, the best available evidence, and expert consensus.
rows.ne: विद्यमान निर्देशिकाहरू, उपलब्ध उत्कृष्ट प्रमाण र विज्ञहरूको सहमति यसका आधार हुन्।
rows.bt: Existing guidelines, the best available evidence and expert consensus are its foundations.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: The goal of the MSP is to contribute to reduced suffering and improved mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.ne: दुःख कम गर्न र मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणमा सुधार ल्याउन योगदान गर्नु MSP को लक्ष्य हो।
rows.bt: The goal of the MSP is to contribute to reducing suffering and improving mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Mental health and psychosocial well-being wording is reused from supplied unreviewed candidates.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: For more information on what the MSP is, why it is needed and how it can be used, please refer to the MSP guide.
rows.ne: MSP के हो, यो किन आवश्यक छ र यसलाई कसरी प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ भन्नेबारे थप जानकारीका लागि MSP मार्गदर्शिका हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For more information about what the MSP is, why it is needed and how it can be used, see the MSP guide.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: How is it relevant to Nutrition actors?
rows.ne: पोषण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूका लागि यो कसरी सान्दर्भिक छ?
rows.bt: How is this relevant to actors working in the nutrition sector?

rows.section: How is it relevant to Nutrition actors?
rows.en: The cognitive, social, and emotional development of children depends on both adequate nutrition and nurturing care.
rows.ne: बालबालिकाको संज्ञानात्मक, सामाजिक र भावनात्मक विकास पर्याप्त पोषण र बाल विकासलाई पोषण गर्ने स्याहार दुवैमा निर्भर हुन्छ।
rows.bt: Children's cognitive, social and emotional development depends on both adequate nutrition and care that nurtures child development.
rows.note: Describes ordinary child development, not a diagnosis or clinical intervention.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Nutrition actors?
rows.en: Emergencies can severely limit caregivers’ abilities to provide these, due to interruptions to the food supply and strain on their own mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.ne: खाद्य आपूर्तिमा अवरोध र हेरचाहकर्ताको आफ्नै मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणमा पर्ने दबाबका कारण आपत्कालले यी दुवै उपलब्ध गराउने उनीहरूको क्षमतालाई गम्भीर रूपमा सीमित गर्न सक्छ।
rows.bt: Emergencies can severely limit their ability to provide both of these because of disruptions to food supplies and pressure on caregivers' own mental health and psychosocial well-being.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Nutrition actors?
rows.en: Nutrition, mental health, and child development are interlinked in a range of ways that can be disrupted in emergencies.
rows.ne: पोषण, मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र बाल विकास विभिन्न तरिकाले एकअर्कासँग जोडिएका छन्, र आपत्कालमा यी सम्बन्धहरू अवरुद्ध हुन सक्छन्।
rows.bt: Nutrition, mental health and child development are connected to one another in various ways, and these connections can be disrupted in emergencies.
rows.note: The mental health wording occurs in the supplied unreviewed candidates; no new diagnostic terminology is introduced.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Nutrition actors?
rows.en: For example, malnourished children may show reduced activity and seek less interaction with caregivers; where caregivers consequently reduce the amount of stimulation provided, this can lead to further developmental disadvantages.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, कुपोषित बालबालिकाले कम सक्रियता देखाउन सक्छन् र हेरचाहकर्तासँग अन्तरक्रिया गर्न कम खोज्न सक्छन्; यसकै परिणामस्वरूप हेरचाहकर्ताले उपलब्ध गराउने उद्दीपनको मात्रा घटाएमा, यसले बालबालिकाको विकासमा थप प्रतिकूल असर पार्न सक्छ।
rows.bt: For example, malnourished children may show less activity and may seek less to interact with the caregiver; if, as a result of this, the caregiver reduces the amount of stimulation they provide, this may have a further adverse effect on the children's development.
rows.note: Preserves reduced activity and interaction as possibilities, and further developmental disadvantage as conditional on caregivers consequently reducing stimulation.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Nutrition actors?
rows.en: Caregiver well-being can also impact child nutrition; for example, mothers experiencing depression are less likely to continue breastfeeding their child and provide less stimulation.
rows.ne: हेरचाहकर्ताको कल्याणले बालबालिकाको पोषणमा पनि प्रभाव पार्न सक्छ; उदाहरणका लागि, [depression] अनुभव गरिरहेका आमाहरूले आफ्नो बच्चालाई स्तनपान गराइरहने सम्भावना कम हुन्छ र उनीहरूले कम उद्दीपन प्रदान गर्छन्।
rows.bt: The caregiver's well-being can also affect children's nutrition; for example, mothers experiencing [depression] are less likely to continue breastfeeding their child and they provide less stimulation.
rows.note: Retains the diagnosis in exact source English and distinguishes the lower likelihood of continued breastfeeding from the statement about reduced stimulation.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Nutrition actors?
rows.en: The MSP outlines priority activities Nutrition actors can implement or support to promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of caregivers and their children.
rows.ne: हेरचाहकर्ता र उनीहरूका बालबालिकाको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न पोषण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूले कार्यान्वयन गर्न वा सहयोग गर्न सक्ने प्राथमिकताका गतिविधिहरूको रूपरेखा MSP ले प्रस्तुत गर्छ।
rows.bt: The MSP outlines priority activities that actors working in the nutrition sector can implement or support to promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of caregivers and their children.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Nutrition actors?
rows.en: How do I find Nutrition content in the MSP?
rows.ne: MSP मा पोषणसम्बन्धी सामग्री कसरी फेला पार्ने?
rows.bt: How to find nutrition-related material in the MSP?

rows.section: How do I find Nutrition content in the MSP?
rows.en: Each MSP activity is labelled with icons showing which sectors, clusters, or areas of responsibility (AoRs) are typically well placed to deliver it (colourful icons) or contribute to it (dark blue icons).1
rows.ne: प्रत्येक MSP गतिविधिमा कुन क्षेत्र, क्लस्टर वा जिम्मेवारीका क्षेत्रहरू (AoRs) सामान्यतया उक्त गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् (रङ्गीन चिह्नहरू) वा त्यसमा योगदान गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् (गाढा नीलो चिह्नहरू) भन्ने देखाउने चिह्नहरू राखिएका छन्।1
rows.bt: Each MSP activity includes symbols showing which sectors, clusters or areas of responsibility (AoRs) are generally suitably positioned to conduct that activity (coloured symbols) or to contribute to it (dark blue symbols).1

rows.section: How do I find Nutrition content in the MSP?
rows.en: The pink Nutrition icon indicates that Nutrition actors are typically well-placed to deliver an activity.
rows.ne: पोषणको गुलाबी चिह्नले पोषण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू सामान्यतया गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् भन्ने जनाउँछ।
rows.bt: The pink nutrition symbol indicates that actors working in the nutrition sector are generally suitably positioned to conduct the activity.

rows.section: How do I find Nutrition content in the MSP?
rows.en: The dark-blue Nutrition icon indicates that Nutrition actors are typically well-placed to contribute to the implementation of an activity.
rows.ne: पोषणको गाढा नीलो चिह्नले पोषण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू सामान्यतया गतिविधिको कार्यान्वयनमा योगदान गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् भन्ने जनाउँछ।
rows.bt: The dark blue nutrition symbol indicates that actors working in the nutrition sector are generally suitably positioned to contribute to implementing the activity.

rows.section: How do I find Nutrition content in the MSP?
rows.en: For more information, see Who should implement MSP activities?
rows.ne: थप जानकारीका लागि ‘MSP गतिविधिहरू कसले कार्यान्वयन गर्नुपर्छ?’ हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For more information, see 'Who should implement MSP activities?'

rows.section: How do I find Nutrition content in the MSP?
rows.en: Figure 1 shows activity 3.3, Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being, as an example.
rows.ne: चित्र 1 मा गतिविधि 3.3, ‘मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने’, उदाहरणका रूपमा देखाइएको छ।
rows.bt: Figure 1 shows activity 3.3, 'Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being', as an example.

rows.section: How do I find Nutrition content in the MSP?
rows.en: The colourful icons show that Health, Education, Protection, Child Protection, Gender Based Violence, Mine Action, Nutrition, and Camp Coordination and Camp Management (CCCM) actors, are typically well placed to deliver this activity.
rows.ne: रङ्गीन चिह्नहरूले स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा, संरक्षण, बाल संरक्षण, लैङ्गिक हिंसा, बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्य, पोषण र शिविर समन्वय तथा शिविर व्यवस्थापन (CCCM) क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू सामान्यतया यो गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन्।
rows.bt: The coloured symbols show that actors working in health, education, protection, child protection, gender-based violence, landmine-related action, nutrition and camp coordination and camp management (CCCM) are generally suitably positioned to conduct this activity.
rows.note: Reclassified as general because this is a sector-role description, not a safety instruction or safeguarding declaration. Gender Based Violence is a recurring sector label missing from the frozen glossary; a candidate is proposed separately.

rows.section: How do I find Nutrition content in the MSP?
rows.en: For example, nutrition actors can collaborate with MHPSS experts to develop key messages that establish linkages between nutrition outcomes and the mental health and psychosocial well-being of infants and their caregivers.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, पोषण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूले पोषणका नतिजा र शिशु तथा उनीहरूका हेरचाहकर्ताको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणबीच सम्बन्ध स्थापित गर्ने मुख्य सन्देशहरू विकास गर्न MHPSS विज्ञहरूसँग सहकार्य गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: For example, actors working in the nutrition sector can collaborate with MHPSS experts to develop key messages that establish a link between nutrition outcomes and the mental health and psychosocial well-being of infants and their caregivers.

rows.section: How do I find Nutrition content in the MSP?
rows.en: The dark blue icons show that Shelter and Settlements, WASH and Food Security and Livelihoods actors are typically well placed to contribute to this activity, for example, by supporting dissemination efforts.
rows.ne: गाढा नीलो चिह्नहरूले आश्रय तथा बस्ती, WASH र खाद्य सुरक्षा तथा जीविकोपार्जन क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू सामान्यतया यो गतिविधिमा योगदान गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन्; उदाहरणका लागि, उनीहरूले प्रसारका प्रयासहरूमा सहयोग गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: The dark blue symbols show that actors working in shelter and settlements, WASH and food security and livelihoods are generally suitably positioned to contribute to this activity; for example, they can support dissemination efforts.
rows.note: WASH is a recurring sector acronym missing from the frozen glossary. It is retained unchanged; a candidate glossary entry is proposed separately.

rows.section: How do I find Nutrition content in the MSP?
rows.en: Figure 2 presents another example.
rows.ne: चित्र 2 मा अर्को उदाहरण प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ।
rows.bt: Another example is presented in Figure 2.

rows.section: How do I find Nutrition content in the MSP?
rows.en: Here the colourful icon shows that Health actors are typically well placed to deliver activity 3.10, Provide mental health care as part of general health services, while the dark blue icons show that Child Protection and Nutrition actors are typically well-placed to contribute to it.
rows.ne: यहाँ रङ्गीन चिह्नले स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू सामान्यतया गतिविधि 3.10, ‘सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाको अङ्गका रूपमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदान गर्ने’, सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् भन्ने देखाउँछ, जबकि गाढा नीलो चिह्नहरूले बाल संरक्षण र पोषण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू सामान्यतया यसमा योगदान गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन्।
rows.bt: Here, the coloured symbol shows that actors working in the health sector are generally suitably positioned to conduct activity 3.10, 'Provide mental health care as part of general health services', while the dark blue symbols show that actors working in child protection and nutrition are generally suitably positioned to contribute to it.
rows.note: The activity label is reused verbatim from the supplied unreviewed candidate.

rows.section: How do I find Nutrition content in the MSP?
rows.en: For example, Nutrition actors can contribute by establishing referral pathways and links to general health services, and supporting children and caregivers with mental, neurological or substance use conditions to access such services.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, पोषण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूले सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवासम्म पुग्ने सेवा प्रेषण मार्गहरू र ती सेवासँग सम्पर्कहरू स्थापना गरेर तथा मानसिक, स्नायुसम्बन्धी वा पदार्थ प्रयोगसम्बन्धी अवस्था भएका बालबालिका तथा हेरचाहकर्ताहरूलाई त्यस्ता सेवामा पहुँच पाउन सहयोग गरेर योगदान दिन सक्छन्।
rows.bt: For example, actors working in the nutrition sector can contribute by establishing referral pathways leading to general health services and connections with those services, and by helping children and caregivers with mental, neurological or substance use-related conditions to access such services.
rows.note: Preserves the actor, the possibility of contributing, and all three condition categories without narrowing them to named diagnoses.

rows.bt: Which MSP activities are most relevant for actors working in the nutrition sector?

rows.section: Which MSP activities are most relevant to Nutrition actors?
rows.en: MSP activities are organized into four sections.

rows.bt: Section 1: Inter-agency coordination and assessment
rows.note: Inter-agency coordination recurs but has no entry in G-0.1; a wording proposal is listed separately.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Activities 1.1 and 1.2 are particularly relevant for coordination groups in all sectors and AoRs, and cross-cutting MHPSS technical working groups.
rows.ne: गतिविधि 1.1 र 1.2 सबै क्षेत्र तथा AoRs का समन्वय समूहहरू र विभिन्न क्षेत्रलाई समेट्ने MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूहहरूका लागि विशेष रूपमा सान्दर्भिक छन्।
rows.bt: Activities 1.1 and 1.2 are particularly relevant for the coordination groups of all sectors and AoRs and MHPSS technical working groups covering various sectors.
rows.note: The source describes cross-cutting MHPSS technical working groups, not merely groups related to various sectors. The revision restores their cross-sector scope.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: They promote effective inter-agency and intersectoral coordination and assessment.
rows.ne: यी गतिविधिहरूले प्रभावकारी अन्तरनिकाय तथा अन्तरक्षेत्रीय समन्वय र लेखाजोखालाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्छन्।
rows.bt: These activities promote effective inter-agency and inter-sectoral coordination and assessment.
rows.note: Uses the proposed wording for inter-agency coordination; the frozen glossary is unchanged.

rows.bt: Relevance for actors working in the nutrition sector2
rows.note: Uses the proposed wording for Nutrition actors. The attached footnote marker 2 is preserved.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.ne: 1.1 क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने।
rows.bt: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and between sectors.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Establishing communication between MHPSS TWG and Nutrition cluster, e.g. information sharing and discussions of areas for potential collaboration. Developing referral mechanisms and ensuring access to MHPSS activities for pregnant women, young children and caregivers.
rows.ne: MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (TWG) र पोषण क्लस्टरबीच सञ्चार स्थापित गर्ने, उदाहरणका लागि सूचना आदानप्रदान गर्ने र सम्भावित सहकार्यका क्षेत्रहरूबारे छलफल गर्ने। सेवा प्रेषण संयन्त्रहरू विकास गर्ने र गर्भवती महिला, साना बालबालिका तथा हेरचाहकर्ताका लागि MHPSS गतिविधिहरूमा पहुँच सुनिश्चित गर्ने।
rows.bt: Establish communication between the MHPSS technical working group (TWG) and the nutrition cluster, for example, exchange information and discuss possible areas of collaboration. Develop service referral mechanisms and ensure access to MHPSS activities for pregnant women, young children and caregivers.
rows.note: General coordination and referral guidance drafted for review; safety review remains pending.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide programming
rows.ne: 1.2 कार्यक्रमलाई दिशा दिन MHPSS आवश्यकता र स्रोतहरूको लेखाजोखा गर्ने।
rows.bt: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide the programme.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Including MHPSS in Nutrition needs assessments.
rows.ne: पोषणसम्बन्धी आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखामा MHPSS समावेश गर्ने।
rows.bt: Include MHPSS in the assessment of nutrition-related needs.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.ne: खण्ड 2: सबै MHPSS कार्यक्रमका अत्यावश्यक घटकहरू
rows.bt: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes

rows.section: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.en: Section 2 activities (on programme design, implementing an M&E system, caring for staff and volunteers and supporting MHPSS competencies) should be implemented by all organizations delivering MHPSS activities.
rows.ne: MHPSS गतिविधिहरू सञ्चालन गर्ने सबै संस्थाले खण्ड 2 का गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्नु उचित हुन्छ। यी गतिविधिहरू कार्यक्रमको डिजाइन, अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन (M&E) प्रणालीको कार्यान्वयन, कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकको हेरचाह तथा MHPSS सक्षमतामा सहयोग गर्नेसँग सम्बन्धित छन्।
rows.bt: It is appropriate for all organizations conducting MHPSS activities to implement the activities in Section 2. These activities relate to programme design, implementation of monitoring and evaluation (M&E) systems, care for staff and volunteers, and supporting MHPSS competencies.
rows.note: M&E system is absent as a standalone term from G-0.1. Its wording follows the supplied activity 2.2 label; a glossary proposal is listed separately. The original Nepali strengthens 'should' to 'must' and adds that the MHPSS competencies belong specifically to staff and volunteers. The revision restores recommendation strength and removes that unsupported restriction. The back-translation describes implementation as appropriate rather than explicitly recommending that all organizations delivering MHPSS activities implement the Section 2 activities, weakening the source's 'should'.

rows.section: Section 2 activities (on programme design, implementing an M&E system, caring for staff and volunteers and supporting MHPSS competencies) should be implemented by all organizations delivering MHPSS activities.
rows.en: Sections 3 & 4: MHPSS Programme Activities
rows.ne: खण्ड 3 र 4: MHPSS कार्यक्रमका गतिविधिहरू
rows.bt: Sections 3 and 4: MHPSS programme activities

rows.section: Sections 3 & 4: MHPSS Programme Activities
rows.en: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.ne: पोषण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू सामान्यतया निम्न कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरू सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन्:
rows.bt: Actors working in the nutrition sector are generally well placed to conduct the following programme activities:
rows.note: Uses the proposed wording for Nutrition actors; direct delivery is distinguished from contribution.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: 3.3 मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Clinical wording is reused verbatim from the cited unreviewed T100 candidate.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Identifying and integrating relevant key MHPSS messages into nutrition activities and informational materials.
rows.ne: सान्दर्भिक मुख्य MHPSS सन्देशहरू पहिचान गरी पोषणसम्बन्धी गतिविधि र सूचनामूलक सामग्रीमा एकीकृत गर्ने।
rows.bt: Identify relevant key MHPSS messages and integrate them into nutrition-related activities and informational materials.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.5 Provide early childhood development (ECD) activities to support young children and their caregivers
rows.ne: 3.5 साना बालबालिका र तिनका हेरचाहकर्तालाई सहयोग गर्न प्रारम्भिक बाल विकास (ECD) गतिविधि प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.5 Provide early childhood development (ECD) activities to support young children and their caregivers.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Supporting the mental health and well-being of caregivers of young children, of those expecting children and of young children. Supporting new and expectant caregivers to provide responsive care and early learning opportunities for the children in their care by integrating ECD in nutrition programming. Providing young children with safe opportunities to play and learn.
rows.ne: साना बालबालिकाका हेरचाहकर्ता, सन्तानको प्रतीक्षामा रहेका व्यक्ति र साना बालबालिकाको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र कल्याणलाई सहयोग गर्ने। पोषणसम्बन्धी कार्यक्रममा प्रारम्भिक बाल विकास (ECD) एकीकृत गरी नयाँ हेरचाहकर्ता तथा हेरचाहकर्ताको भूमिका लिन लागेका व्यक्तिहरूलाई आफ्नो हेरचाहमा रहेका बालबालिकाका लागि बालबालिकाका आवश्यकता र सङ्केतअनुसार गरिने स्याहार र प्रारम्भिक सिकाइका अवसरहरू प्रदान गर्न सहयोग गर्ने। साना बालबालिकालाई खेल्न र सिक्न सुरक्षित अवसरहरू प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: Support the mental health and well-being of caregivers of young children, people expecting a child and young children. Integrate early childhood development (ECD) into nutrition-related programmes to help new caregivers and people about to take on the caregiver role provide care according to children's needs and cues and early learning opportunities for the children in their care. Provide young children with safe opportunities to play and learn.
rows.note: Mental-health wording is reused from the cited unreviewed T104 candidate. Well-being here is not expanded to psychosocial well-being. Both existing and expectant caregivers are retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: 3.7 Promote caregivers’ mental health and psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to support children
rows.ne: 3.7 हेरचाहकर्ताको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने र बालबालिकालाई सहयोग गर्ने उनीहरूको क्षमता सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.7 Promote caregivers' mental health and psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to support children.
rows.note: Clinical wording is reused verbatim from the cited unreviewed T104 candidate.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: Supporting caregivers to look after their own physical and mental health needs and promoting positive caregiving skills.
rows.ne: हेरचाहकर्तालाई आफ्नै शारीरिक र मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी आवश्यकताहरू पूरा गर्न सहयोग गर्ने र सकारात्मक हेरचाह गर्ने सीपहरू प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने।
rows.bt: Support caregivers in meeting their own physical and mental health needs and promote positive caregiving skills.
rows.note: Mental-health wording is reused from the cited unreviewed T104 candidate; no new clinical intervention terminology is introduced.

rows.bt: 2 These examples should not be taken as a complete list.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to deliver are:
rows.en: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.ne: पोषण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू सामान्यतया निम्न कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरूमा योगदान दिन उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन्:
rows.bt: Actors working in the nutrition sector are generally well placed to contribute to the following programme activities:
rows.note: Uses the proposed wording for Nutrition actors; contribution is distinguished from direct delivery.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS considerations and actions
rows.ne: 3.1 मानवीय कर्ता र समुदायका सदस्यलाई MHPSS बारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने र MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष तथा कार्यका लागि पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS-related considerations and actions.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Orienting Nutrition actors on MHPSS and interlinkages between MHPSS and Nutrition. Advocating for the integration of MHPSS in Nutrition programming. Providing nutrition services in ways that support mental health and psychosocial well-being, for example, by ensuring that nutrition services are provided in a dignified manner and in a safe and culturally appropriate environment. Accounting for MHPSS considerations in the design of therapeutic feeding centres and outpatient therapeutic programmes. Ensuring that Nutrition activities and services are accessible to and consider the specific needs of people with mental health conditions.
rows.ne: पोषण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरूलाई MHPSS तथा MHPSS र पोषणबीचका अन्तरसम्बन्धबारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने। पोषणसम्बन्धी कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा MHPSS को एकीकरणका लागि वकालत गर्ने। मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणलाई सहयोग पुग्ने गरी पोषण सेवाहरू प्रदान गर्ने, उदाहरणका लागि, पोषण सेवाहरू मर्यादापूर्ण ढङ्गले तथा सुरक्षित र सांस्कृतिक रूपमा उपयुक्त वातावरणमा प्रदान गरिने कुरा सुनिश्चित गर्ने। उपचारात्मक आहार खुवाउने केन्द्रहरू र बहिरङ्ग उपचारात्मक कार्यक्रमहरूको संरचना तयार गर्दा MHPSS सम्बन्धी पक्षहरूलाई ध्यानमा राख्ने। पोषणसम्बन्धी गतिविधि र सेवाहरू मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्था भएका व्यक्तिहरूका लागि पहुँचयोग्य हुने र तिनले ती व्यक्तिहरूका विशिष्ट आवश्यकताहरूलाई ध्यानमा राख्ने कुरा सुनिश्चित गर्ने।
rows.bt: Orient actors working in the nutrition sector about MHPSS and the interrelationships between MHPSS and nutrition. Advocate for the integration of MHPSS into nutrition-related programme planning and implementation. Provide nutrition services in a way that supports mental health and psychosocial well-being, for example, ensure that nutrition services are provided in a dignified manner and in a safe and culturally appropriate environment. Take MHPSS-related aspects into account when preparing the structure of therapeutic feeding centres and outpatient therapeutic programmes. Ensure that nutrition-related activities and services are accessible to people with mental health conditions and that they take into account those people's specific needs.
rows.note: The feeding centres and outpatient therapeutic programmes are drafted as generic service categories, not treated as formally named therapies.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills
rows.ne: 3.2 अग्रपंक्तिका कार्यकर्ता र सामुदायिक अगुवालाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सीपमा अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills.
rows.note: Psychosocial-support wording is reused verbatim from the cited unreviewed T099 candidate.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Orienting nutrition workers on basic psychosocial support and on nurturing care, including identification and referral of children and adults who may need MHPSS.
rows.ne: पोषण कार्यकर्तालाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग र बाल विकासलाई पोषण गर्ने स्याहारबारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने। यसमा MHPSS आवश्यक पर्न सक्ने बालबालिका र वयस्कको पहिचान तथा सेवा प्रेषणसम्बन्धी अभिमुखीकरण पनि समावेश गर्ने।
rows.bt: Orient nutrition workers on basic psychosocial support and care that nurtures child development. Also include in this orientation the identification and service referral of children and adults who may need MHPSS.
rows.note: Basic psychosocial-support wording is reused from the cited unreviewed T099 candidate. This is general identification and referral guidance, not a diagnostic instruction; safety review remains pending.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: 3.10 Provide mental health care as part of general health services
rows.ne: 3.10 सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाको अङ्गका रूपमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.10 Provide mental health services as part of general health services.
rows.note: Clinical service wording is reused verbatim from the cited unreviewed T107 candidate.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Contributing to the provision of mental health care as part of general health services, for example, by establishing referral pathways and links to general health services, and supporting children and caregivers with mental, neurological or substance use conditions to access such services.
rows.ne: सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाको अङ्गका रूपमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य हेरचाह उपलब्ध गराउन योगदान दिने, उदाहरणका लागि, सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवासम्म पुग्ने सेवा प्रेषण मार्गहरू र ती सेवासँग सम्पर्कहरू स्थापना गरेर तथा मानसिक, स्नायुसम्बन्धी वा पदार्थ प्रयोगसम्बन्धी अवस्था भएका बालबालिका तथा हेरचाहकर्ताहरूलाई त्यस्ता सेवामा पहुँच पाउन सहयोग गरेर।
rows.bt: Contribute to making mental health care available as part of general health services, for example, by establishing referral pathways leading to general health services and connections with those services, and by helping children and caregivers with mental, neurological or substance use-related conditions to access such services.
rows.note: Preserves mental health care within general health services and support for children and caregivers across the three stated condition categories.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: 3.14 Protect and care for people in psychiatric hospitals and other institutions
rows.ne: 3.14 मानसिक अस्पताल तथा अन्य संस्थामा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूको संरक्षण र हेरचाह गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.14 Protect and care for people in psychiatric hospitals and other institutions.
rows.note: Institutional clinical wording is reused verbatim from the cited unreviewed T111 candidate.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Contributing to ensuring that basic needs of children and adults in psychiatric hospitals and other institutions, such as orphanages, are met (e.g. ensuring the provision of food and adequate nutrition).
rows.ne: मानसिक अस्पताल तथा अनाथालयजस्ता अन्य संस्थामा रहेका बालबालिका र वयस्कका आधारभूत आवश्यकताहरू पूरा भएको सुनिश्चित गर्न योगदान गर्ने (जस्तै, खाना र पर्याप्त पोषणको व्यवस्था सुनिश्चित गर्ने)।
rows.bt: Contribute to ensuring that the basic needs of children and adults in other institutions such as mental hospitals and orphanages are met (for example, ensuring the provision of food and adequate nutrition).
rows.note: The psychiatric-hospital term is reused verbatim from the cited unreviewed T015 candidate; specialist review remains pending.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Nutrition actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: You can use the filter on the ‘All Activities’ page of the web platform to show only Nutrition-relevant activities.
rows.ne: पोषणसँग सम्बन्धित गतिविधिहरू मात्र देखाउन वेब प्लेटफर्मको ‘सबै गतिविधिहरू’ (‘All Activities’) पृष्ठमा रहेको फिल्टर प्रयोग गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ।
